name: storytelleros
description: Claude plugins for indie authors using StorytellerOS. Connect your StorytellerOS workspace and orchestrate everything — drafting titles, story bibles, time-tracking, tasks, finance, sales-studio, marketing-studio, calendar — from inside Claude.

plugins.name: storytelleros
plugins.description: Draft titles in Claude (screenplay / audiobook / novel / game — STOS calls them all 'titles'), generate full story bibles, capture tasks, run writing timers, log finance, manage your calendar, and lift sales/marketing assets — without leaving the conversation. Pairs with a StorytellerOS account; the connector is added separately so the credential fields stay editable. Social work routes to the Author Automations plugin.
